desc: Reduce pairing to an even-count (parity) coloring of exactly M=2K cakes and prove equality in both directions.
Implement the O(N log N) parity-repair solution (top-M base U, parity p∈{0,3,5,6}, answer = U − min(g_p, min_compat_qr)).
Verify passes both public samples (12, 209, 333) and hand-checked edge cases (M=N, K=1, all-zero values, tie-heavy).
Prove the top-4 per-bucket truncation is exact for both g_p (rank-1 suffices) and min_compat (r-move touches ≤2 cakes, so ≥2 of the top-4 stay free).
Confirm complexity O(N log N) per test with O(1) candidate work (≤40 per vector, ≤1600 pairs), safe for sum N ≤ 1e5 and T ≤ 1000.
External exhaustive random brute-force sweep and CPython timing benchmark: not runnable in this sandbox; replaced by full proof plus hand-evaluated cases, all matching direct enumeration.
Discarded superseded approaches (Lagrangian/Aliens penalty formulation, naive top-2K-plus-one-recolor, S==0 special case).
